description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Thermopod didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Thermopod is still in your graveyard.
Repeat.
